text:
```yaml
name: Check CLA in PR Descriptions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  cla-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run CLA check script
        id: clareq
        run: npx @convexdev/clareq --pr-description "$PR_DESCRIPTION"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_DESCRIPTION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}

      - name: Fail if CLA is not found
        if: ${{ steps.clareq.outputs.has-cla == 'false' }}
        run: echo "CLA not found in PR description" && exit 1
```
